Box Drawings Up Single And Left Double Alt Code and Symbol

The Alt code for Box Drawings Up Single And Left Double is 190. Hold Alt, type 190 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt. Box Drawings Up Single And Left Double also has the Unicode codepoint U+255B, so you can type it with Alt+9563 on Windows, search for U+255B in macOS's Character Viewer, use ╛ in HTML, or \255B in CSS. If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly — the Alt key method requires a physical numpad. Copy the Box Drawings Up Single And Left Double character from this page when you need it in a form, chat message or document that does not accept Alt codes. Box Drawings Up Single And Left Double has no named HTML entity, so use the numeric escape ╛ or the hex escape ╛.

How to type box drawings up single and left double on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 1 9 0 on the numeric keypad.
  4. Release Alt. The Box Drawings Up Single And Left Double character (╛) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type box drawings up single and left double on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Box Drawings Up Single And Left Double. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Box Drawings Up Single And Left Double" and click the character to insert it.

How to use box drawings up single and left double in code

  • HTML: or
  • CSS: content:"\255B"; ()
  • Python: \u255B or chr(0x255B)
  • JavaScript: \u255B or String.fromCodePoint(0x255B)
  • JSON: "\u255B"

Frequently asked questions

What is the Alt code for Box Drawings Up Single And Left Double?

The legacy Alt code for Box Drawings Up Single And Left Double is 190. Hold Alt, type 1 9 0 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt.

How do I type ╛ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ╛, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+9563 not work?

Alt+9563 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Box Drawings Up Single And Left Double?

The Unicode codepoint for Box Drawings Up Single And Left Double is U+255B. You can use this value in HTML as ╛, in CSS as \255B, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ╛ on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+255B, then click it.
